criteria.text: States that the escrow release date is 10 June 2028 (12 months after the 10 June 2027 Closing Date) and that pending claims must be notified before then.
Identifies that the warranty cap in SPA Section 8.4 is stated as $11,700,000 but 10% of the $130,000,000 Purchase Price is $13,000,000, i.e. the stated figure is wrong.
Identifies that the 5-year SPA non-compete may be unenforceable as wider than reasonably necessary and is inconsistent with the 12-month restriction in the Founder's employment agreement.
States that General Warranty claims must be notified by 10 June 2028 (12 months after Closing) and Fundamental Warranty claims by 10 June 2030 (36 months after Closing).
Identifies the mismatch between English law / English courts in the SPA and New York law / New York arbitration in the escrow agreement, and the risk of parallel proceedings on escrow claims.
Flags the inconsistency between the SPA and employment agreement non-compete periods.
Shows the arithmetic for the cap (10% x $130,000,000 = $13,000,000) and flags the discrepancy with the stated $11,700,000.
Gives a concrete recommended action for each issue (what to request, amend or negotiate).
